user.title: Voice Alarms Setup
user.description: Configure voice alarms for your Assist satellites.

data_description.max_ring_time: How long the alarm rings before stopping automatically (1-120 minutes).
data_description.satellite_devices: All assist_satellite entities that can receive alarms.
data_description.local_satellites: Subset of satellite devices that support on-device ringing. Must be a subset of the selected satellite devices.
data_description.alarm_mode: Choose HA announcements or device-side ringing on selected local satellites.
data_description.sound: The sound played when an alarm fires. Options are discovered from the voice_alarms_sound select entity on each satellite device.

error.satellites_required: At least one satellite device must be selected.
error.local_not_subset: Local satellites must be a subset of the selected satellite devices.
error.sound_not_available: The selected sound is not available on one or more local satellites.

abort.already_configured: Voice Alarms is already configured. Use the options flow to change settings.
